# `gcp.vpcaccess.connector`

Serverless VPC Access connector resource.

[vpcaccess](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | vpcaccess |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `vpcaccess.googleapis.com/Connector` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: encoder (encoders/no_send_name.go.tmpl) deletes name from the create body; name is the connectorId query parameter, so the body never carries it. decoder (decoders/long_name_to_self_link.go.tmpl) is Terraform's self_link bookkeeping. post_create is a 5 second sleep after an awaited operation.
pre_update (pre_update/vpc_access_connector_instances.go.tmpl) sends minInstances and maxInstances together, in body and mask, whenever either changes. BuildMask sends only the one that changed. THE BOUNDED GAP, unverified: if Google insists on the pair, a change to one is refused with its error; change both. Terraform also REPLACES the connector when either decreases; here that is a patch Google refuses.
) |
